specs.Compatible Phone Models: Kindle Paperwhite 12th Gen 2024, Kindle Colorsoft Signature Edition
specs.Item Highlight: Slim PU Shell, Auto Wake/Sleep, Detachable Design, for Everyday Reading and Carrying

features: KINDLE PAPERWHITE TPU EREADER COVER: This protective cover is designed specifically for 7'' Kindle Paperwhite 12th Gen 2024 and offers reliable daily protection in a slim and lightweight form. With a flexible TPU back and smooth leather style front, it shields your device from drops and scratches while maintaining a sleek and professional look.

FULL COVERAGE WITH 2 PIECE DESIGN: The combination of a flexible TPU back cover and a refined leather style front provides strong protection without adding bulk. The TPU absorbs impact from accidental drops while the smooth exterior creates a premium feel that enhances both durability and visual appeal for everyday use.

AUTO WAKE AND SLEEP FUNCTION: The built in magnetic closure activates the automatic wake and sleep feature of the Kindle Paperwhite twelfth generation. Opening the cover instantly wakes your device for reading and closing it puts the screen to sleep to conserve battery life .

REMOVABLE FRONT INSERT: The front cover is a detachable panel that allows you to personalize the look or adjust the functionality of the case. This flexible design makes it easy to remove or replace the insert, offering added convenience and customization based on your preferences.

MAGNETIC CLOSURE AND SCREEN PROTECTION: Strong integrated magnets keep the cover securely closed to prevent accidental openings during travel or daily use. Inside the front cover, a soft anti scratch lining protects the screen from dust fingerprints and scuffs ensuring your reader stays clean and safe at all times.
description: This Kindle Case is designed for Kindle Paperwhite 12th Generation 2024, with a slim profile for readers who want everyday coverage without a bulky feel. It is also compatible with Kindle Colorsoft Signature Edition. Use it at home, during commutes, or while travelling. The cover supports auto wake and sleep, helping your reading session begin and end with less handling. The detachable design lets you use the e-reader with or without the outer cover. Its PU shell provides a structured layer around the device while keeping the case practical for daily carrying. Keep the case away from excessive moisture and heat. Wipe the PU surface with a soft, dry cloth, and check the device fit before use. Confirm your Kindle model and generation before purchase.
